items.prompt:
Create one premium, original, square 1254 × 1254 pixel still illustration for a one-cell Android home-screen widget. Center a midnight-navy circular disc on a genuinely transparent square canvas. Use bold, simple ivory shapes and restrained warm-gold accents with clean edges, high contrast, and a single instantly recognizable visual action. The recurring character is a sculptural numeral 5, but follow the scene's stated visibility or transformation intentionally; an unreadable or absent 5 is allowed when the scene says so. Treat the circular gold ring as movable scenery rather than a mandatory intact border. Keep the full composition safely within a circular 1 × 1 crop. Render for recognition at 56 × 56 pixels, with one dominant silhouette and no tiny explanatory detail. This is a single frozen moment, not a sequence.

The upper loop of a chunky ivory 5 becomes the handle of a single gold kettlebell; the rest of the 5 braces beneath it, with the ring compressed into a low platform. Make the low platform visibly squash the navy disc's lower outline, like the weight deforms the badge itself.

No words, letters other than the intentional numeral 5, extra numerals, logos, signature, watermark, UI, phone, screenshot, grid, checkerboard, square backing, gradients that erase the silhouette, photorealistic humans, cluttered background, duplicate characters, or visual elements crossing the transparent canvas edge. Do not add a second action or make the scene depend on tiny facial features. Keep the outside of the circular disc truly transparent, not a painted transparency pattern. No separate dumbbells, barbell, or tiny grip detail.
